name: Cooldown icon
description: Passive icon: an hourglass, two triangles meeting point-to-point. Port of the hand-drawn i_cooldown from Feelers' BootScene. Rim is `$husk`, the same as `ss.icon.whip`: this passive is the Lash evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar.
